name: Macro Recorder Pro
headline: RECORD -> DO IT -> REPLAY
description: Record keyboard and mouse macros by performing them once. Macro Recorder Pro captures keystrokes, mouse buttons, movement, drag, scroll and timing on Windows, then lets you replay from Stream Deck with speed controls, repeat count, repeat while held, toggle repeat, a reusable Macro Library, timeline editing and PackRat macro import/export. No scripting language and no macro upload.
release_notes:
- Record keyboard, mouse buttons, movement, drag, wheel and timing.
- Replay macros with 0.25x-4x speed, repeat count, while-held and toggle modes.
- Manage reusable local macros with rename, duplicate, timeline editing, refresh, import/export and deep troubleshooting.
- Includes minimal Record / Play / Stop starter profiles for Stream Deck, Mini, XL, Plus and Neo.
tagline: Record keyboard + mouse workflows once. Replay them from Stream Deck.
privacy: Macro contents are never uploaded to PackRat. The reusable Macro Library is stored locally in AppData; macro contents leave the library only when the user explicitly exports a PackRat macro file.
limitations: Playback uses the Windows SendInput API and may be blocked when the target app runs at a higher Administrator integrity level than Stream Deck.
Windows secure desktop, including UAC secure prompts, is outside normal recording and playback.
